verdict.rationale: Publishing source code or models under an open license is a fair question for an AI video generation product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only a proprietary, credit-billed API, SDKs and docs (including per-endpoint OpenAPI definitions). None of it mentions open-source code, a public repository or an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
